subtitle: The books can wait. The workers cannot.
briefing: Reach the wreck and recover the ledger. The rescue boat arrives at high tide on turn 6. Once the boat is here and the wreck is yours, defend it through three enemy turns to get the workers out.
debrief: The last worker leaves with the ledger. Senn had paid Vale to seize the posts, then charged the villagers for salvage they never requested. Tomas deserted when ordered to burn the hull with workers inside. He knows the wooded route to the upper gate.
hints: Reach the wreck on the central sandbar. Rescue starts at high tide on turn 6; then defend it for three enemy turns.
Land allies use the northern sandbar and wooded shore; merfolk flank through sea and marshes.
Enemy recapture resets the rescue counter. You can leave the wreck, but keep it under your control.

intro.text: I was hired to guard a salvage crew. Today Senn ordered us to set the ship alight. There are still people down there.
The rescue boat can enter this channel at high tide. First, get us to the wreck. Nobody touches the quarry gate while people are still inside.
The factor's ledger is company property. Clear the landing and burn the books.
A debt cannot give you ownership of a person. We take the wreck and get everyone out.

victory.text: Last boat away. The clerk brought the books with her. Every order, every payment.
Senn has shut the upper gate now. If we open only the lower one, the quarry water will flood the village. We need both controls and the beacon.
